projects.title: Klosiq
projects.subtitle: Virtual try-on application
projects.role: Senior Software Engineer — distributed architecture and GPU ML pipelines
projects.summary: Privacy-first virtual try-on on Flutter + GKE microservices, with LEFFA GPU inference and on-device looks.
projects.challenge: Deliver production virtual try-on for garments and accessories while keeping sensitive try-on assets off the server by default and coordinating GPU inference with mobile clients.
responsibilities: Owned backend architecture and delivery across accounts, try-on, looks-sharing, and recommendation services.
Contributed Flutter app features (wardrobe, Create Look, Accessorize, Style Me).
Owned Traefik edge routing, GKE/Dapr platform paths, and Nova ComfyUI GPU try-on integration.
solution: Flutter clients (klosiq-ui) authenticate with Firebase OTP, then call the Traefik API gateway over HTTPS/gRPC with session and device-bound headers.
Split backend into accounts (FastAPI), tryon-service (gRPC + REST), looks-sharing (FastAPI), and recommendation (FashionSigLIP CPU) — with Dapr sidecars on the core services.
tryon-service drives sync gRPC try-on against Nova ComfyUI (TRYON_ENGINE=comfyui; LEFFA workflows) and uses Dapr invoke to auto-create looks in looks-sharing.
Postgres 17 holds accounts and looks_sharing schemas; Redis 7 for cache/pubsub; GCS for blobs, looks, and model checkpoints.
Kept wardrobe and private looks on-device with ObjectBox; on-device MobileNetV3 classification plus ML Kit / Apple Vision background removal.

outcomes.label: Try-on asset retention
outcomes.context: Looks, garments, and results stored in ObjectBox to reduce server-side retention of sensitive assets

outcomes.label: Accessory categories
outcomes.context: Belts, bags, earrings, shoes alongside garments

projects.confidentialityNotes: No proprietary model weights, customer images, or internal credentials are shown. Architecture is described at a systems level only.

projects.title: Retyre
projects.subtitle: Tyre recycling platform
projects.role: Senior Software Engineer — backend, auth, deployment
projects.summary: Admin, Customer, and Driver apps with geo routing, realtime tracking, and Kanidm central auth.
projects.challenge: Coordinate Admin, Customer, and Driver workflows across web and mobile with reliable geo matching, realtime updates, and unified identity.
responsibilities: Designed FastAPI/gRPC microservices with Dapr on GCP.
solution: Built Admin portal in React and Customer/Driver apps in React Native for iOS and Android.
Implemented Kanidm central authentication across Admin, Customer, and Driver services.
Geo-aware registration near recycling sites (approximately 10 km radius) with automated booking routing and driver slot assignment.
Realtime driver tracking and customer–driver chat over WebSockets; Redis for caching/messaging; PostgreSQL as system of record.
Deployed with Docker/Buildah, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD/Flux CD, OpenTofu, Ansible, and Headlamp.

outcomes.label: Automated dispatch
outcomes.context: Zero manual routing for matched booking requests

projects.confidentialityNotes: No customer PII, site coordinates beyond approximate radius, or payment credentials are published.

projects.title: CRS Application
projects.subtitle: Customer Relationship Service — attendance at scale
projects.role: Python Developer — backend and React UI
projects.summary: FastAPI attendance backend for ~40K employees and ~3.6M monthly records, with a React ops UI.
projects.challenge: Ingest and report on high monthly attendance volumes while keeping load windows within operational limits.
responsibilities: Designed FastAPI APIs secured with JWT and OAuth2.
Optimized batch DataFrame inserts with multithreading and connection pooling.
Built React UI surfaces and Swagger-documented contracts.
solution: Built FastAPI CRS backend for workforce attendance at ~40k employees / ~3.6M attendance records per month.
Used batch DataFrame processing, multithreading, semaphores, and connection pooling for monthly load windows.
Improved analytical report queries with indexing and caching; documented APIs with Swagger UI.
projects.confidentialityNotes: Employee counts are approximate product scale figures; no employer datasets are published.

projects.subtitle: Cloud analysis platform
